New home screen: Quick Actions (Record, New Note, Scan, Chat) and Recent Notes / Recordings carousels.
Revamped widget & notifications: one-tap Record and New Note shortcuts with a sleek gradient design.
Record screen redesign: pulsing record button, compact options, live preview with Save-as-Note, and a cleaner overflow menu.
Notes screen polish: top-bar menu (New, Select, Sort) and a tidier note detail menu; removed overlapping delete buttons.
Scanner upgrades: wrapped language chips, a framing-guide overlay, and a language badge on extracted text.
YouTube screen: overflow menu (paste / new search), clearer actions, and a centered, more helpful empty state.
Chat bubbles: Copy / Regenerate / Delete moved into a tidy overflow menu; centered empty-state hint.
Settings redesign: grouped cards with standard dropdowns for model, font, theme, and more.
Bottom navigation simplified to 5 items with a \'More\' sheet for YouTube, Chat, and Settings.
Consistent Material 3 styling, rounded surfaces, and themed accents applied across all screens.
Fixes: swipe-to-dismiss delete no longer overlaps icons; smoother, cleaner layouts throughout.

NoteFlow AI is built to run state-of-the-art AI locally on your device. Download these free on-device models in Settings to make full use of the app:
Easily configured anytime under Settings > AI Intelligence
Powers local chat, smart summaries, and reasoning on your device CPU/NPU with zero cloud cost and 100% privacy.

To create a note, reply with exactly this format (one block, no extra text before or after):
CREATE_NOTE
TITLE: <note title>
CATEGORY: <category or All>
CONTENT: <note content>
Then say something short to the user about the note.
